interpretation: 'The last 3 layers of the pretrained network' = the last three top-level modules of model.features (features[16], features[17], features[18]). Each top-level entry of torchvision's model.features is one layer unit of the network (the first conv, 17 inverted-residual bottleneck blocks, the final 1x1 conv); this reading includes the true final layer and keeps each bottleneck block whole. The new 10-class classifier is trained as well, as in every MobileNetV2 variant of the assignment.

last_3_inverted_residual_blocks.rejected_because: leaves the actual last layer features[18] frozen

last_3_parameterised_leaf_ops.rejected_because: splits an inverted-residual block and counts BatchNorm as a layer

change_vs_question1: after freezing model.features (as in Q1), requires_grad=True for features[16], features[17], features[18]; everything else identical
batchnorm: model.train() during training, as in the original script: running mean/variance of every BatchNorm layer (frozen or not) are updated; frozen layers keep their weights and biases
classifier: classifier[1] replaced by Linear(1280, 10) after seeding (same as Question 1)

hyperparameters.optimizer: Adam (all model parameters; frozen ones receive no gradient and are not updated)

timing_definitions.train_seconds: All epochs: DataLoader iteration (incl. CPU transforms), host->device copies (no-op on CPU), forward/backward/step. Excludes dataset loading and model construction. Device synchronized at start and end (no-op on CPU).
timing_definitions.inference_seconds: Full pass over the test set: DataLoader iteration, host->device copies, forward, argmax. Excludes copying predictions to CPU and accuracy computation. Device synchronized at start and end (no-op on CPU).
